name: Preservation of Tiatr Literature
benefit:
##### ***Printing Services*** - Tiatr Academy of Goa will print scripts of tiatrs/khell tiatrs/khells, one-act plays, lyrics of kantaram with or without music in book form in Konkani in Roman Script. - Minimum of 500 copies of each book will be printed.
##### ***Category-wise Benefits*** > ***Category I (Deceased or Inactive Tiatr Artistes)*** - One-time honorarium as fixed by Tiatr Acade
_eligibility_text: ##### **General Eligibility** The applicant must be a tiatr artiste or the legal heir of a deceased tiatr artiste. ##### **Category-wise Eligibility** ***Category I:*** - The applicant must be a tiatr artiste who has expired or is living but not active on the tiatr stage. - The applicant must submit scripts of Tiatr/Khell tiatr/Khell/One Act Plays. - The applicant must have a minimum collection of 50 songs with or without musical scores if submitting only songs (kantaram). ***Category II:*** - The applicant must be a tiatr artist who is active on the tiatr stage. - The applicant must submit scripts of Tiatr/Khell tiatr/Khell/One Act Plays. - The applicant must have a minimum collection of 100 songs with or without musical scores if submitting only songs (kantaram). ***Category III:*** - The applicant must be an individual artist/publisher who wishes to publish Scripts of Tiatr/Khell tiatr/Khell/One Act Plays on his/her own. - The applicant must ensure the book conforms to all norms of the scheme. ##### ***Preference*** Scripts/lyrics/music written by tiatr artistes of yesteryears will be given first preference.
